title: StorageClass parameter blockExpress is deprecated and ignored; new io2 volumes cap at 256,000 IOPS

detection.reason: StorageClass parameters are not collected yet (Storage tab slice); the hint names the EBS CSI StorageClasses

quote: The `blockExpress` StorageClass parameter is deprecated, effective immediately
remediation: Remove blockExpress from io2 StorageClasses: from v1.47 it only logs a deprecation warning, and every new io2 volume is Block Express (up to 256,000 IOPS). Volumes above 64,000 IOPS may not reach full performance on non-Nitro instances.
verifyCommand: kubectl get storageclass -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.provisioner == "ebs.csi.aws.com") | "\(.metadata.name): \(.parameters // {} | to_entries | map("\(.key)=\(.value)") | join(" "))"'  # a parameter blockExpress=… is ignored from v1.47
coversNotes: URGENT (1.47.0): Starting in v1.47.0, newly created io2 volumes will always use a cap of 256,000 IOPS,
